title: A percentage over ALL ( Customer ) is of what the roles let the user see

source.quote: we are not computing the percentage against all sales but the percentage against the sales we are allowed to see.
source.supports: with roles, the denominator is the total of the visible sales

derivation: Europe and Australia together see Ann, Bob and Di: sales 130 (Europe) + 30 (Australia) = 160. Europe 130 / 160 = 0.8125; Australia 30 / 160 = 0.1875. Asia's customer is not visible, so it has no row.
